summary: Chapter Worlds Polish verification passed. All 11 chapters settle within watchdog cap (~1.8s-4.9s including polling latency); every chapter renders its main content. Legacy title reveals to opacity 1 by ~1.5s after landing; Moment redesign renders kicker + 4 stats (9/7/15/480K) + 9-year rail (2008-2024) reaching opacity 1 by ~3s post-landing. Keyboard soak: from hero, 12 ArrowDowns walk sequentially through every chapter (top->legacy->timeline->cars->gallery->records->milestones->tracks->moment->quotes->victories->footer at press 11); no crashes, traveling always returns to false. McLaren theme swap works (visually confirmed orange/Vodafone livery on hero).
critical_code_review_comments: MomentChapter years rail: total reveal takes ~3s (0.35s base delay + 0.6s duration + per-year stagger up to ~2s). If a test naively snapshots at <3s, years appear invisible. Consider tightening stagger or exposing a 'ready' marker.

Legacy title reveal has 0.18s CSS animation delay before the 0.9s legacyReveal. Under Lenis smooth-scroll landing, title stays at opacity 0 until ~1.2-1.5s after data-traveling flips false. Not a bug, but worth noting for downstream tests: poll opacity for up to 2s before failing.

theme swap: McLaren/Mercedes/Ferrari buttons apply theming via CSS variables scoped somewhere below documentElement/body (no data-team attribute set at html/body/root). Tests that check theme via [data-team] on <html> will fail; instead verify via active button aria-pressed / classlist or computed background color.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chapter soak fully passes at 1920x800. Per-chapter settle times (window.__spatialGo -> data-traveling='false' with 300ms polling): legacy 5.9s (first-load includes 3D warmup), timeline 4.1s, cars 3.8s, gallery 4.8s, records 1.9s, milestones 1.8s, tracks 4.5s, moment 4.8s, quotes 2.2s, victories 3.7s, footer 4.7s. Watchdog is effective - no stuck traveling observed. For animation opacity checks: wait ~2s for Legacy reveal and ~3s for Moment year rail. Keyboard nav is snap-per-press, one chapter step, so from 'top' need 11 presses to reach 'footer'.
